bio: Former Lead Engineer at a Series B fintech — scaled to 2M MAU
Open-source contributor with 3,400+ GitHub stars across personal projects
Speaker at JSConf EU 2023 on edge-rendered architecture
Based in Berlin, available for remote collaboration worldwide

expertise.title: Frontend Engineering
expertise.description: I build performant, accessible interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I treat the browser as a first-class runtime: optimising Core Web Vitals, crafting motion that feels earned, and writing component APIs that other developers actually enjoy using.

expertise.title: Backend & Systems Design
expertise.description: Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, and Redis are my daily tools. I design APIs that scale gracefully, architect event-driven systems, and take database performance personally. I've shipped services handling tens of thousands of requests per second.

expertise.title: Product Thinking
expertise.description: I don't just implement specs; I question them. I work best with teams who want an engineer who can sit in a discovery session, challenge assumptions, and come back with a solution that's simpler than what was asked for.

expertise.title: Design Systems
expertise.description: I've built and maintained design systems used by teams of 30+ designers and engineers. Tokens, documentation, Storybook, versioned releases — I understand what it takes to make a system that scales without becoming a bureaucracy.

expertise.title: DevOps & Deployment
expertise.description: Vercel, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions. I own the full deployment pipeline on most of my projects, because shipping fast and safely shouldn't require a dedicated ops team.

expertise.title: Technical Leadership
expertise.description: I've mentored junior engineers, run architecture reviews, and written the kind of technical documentation that people actually read. I believe the best senior engineers make everyone around them faster.

timeline.event: Launched Meridian, an open-source edge-caching library for Next.js App Router, reaching 1,200 GitHub stars in its first month and featured in the Next.js weekly newsletter.
Spoke at JSConf EU in Hamburg on 'Edge-First Architecture: Rethinking Where Code Lives'. Went independent after four years in-house, taking on select client projects and advisory roles.

Lead Engineer at Vaulta (Berlin, fintech). Rebuilt the core payments API in Go, reducing p99 latency from 420ms to 38ms. Grew the engineering team from 4 to 14 and introduced a design-system-first workflow.

Senior Frontend Developer at Arkwright Studio (London, digital agency). Delivered 20+ client projects including a Webby-nominated interactive documentary for the BBC and a real-time data dashboard for the European Space Agency.
Junior Developer at Stackline Labs (remote startup). First production role — shipped features daily, learned to write tests the hard way, and fell in love with the craft of building software.
BSc Computer Science, University of Edinburgh. Graduated with First Class Honours. Dissertation on adaptive UI personalisation using reinforcement learning.

faq.question: Are you available for freelance work?
faq.answer: Yes, I take on select freelance projects throughout the year. I prioritize long-term collaborations and product-focused work over one-off tasks. Reach out with your timeline and scope and we'll see if it's a good fit.

faq.question: What's your typical response time?
faq.answer: I aim to reply to all messages within 24 hours on weekdays. For urgent inquiries, mention it in the subject line and I'll prioritize accordingly.

faq.question: Do you work with international clients?
faq.answer: Absolutely. I've collaborated with teams across Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia. I'm comfortable working across time zones and async-first environments.

faq.question: What information should I include in my first message?
faq.answer: A brief description of the project, your expected timeline, budget range (if applicable), and any reference links or inspiration you have in mind. The more context, the better.

faq.question: Do you offer design-only or development-only engagements?
faq.answer: Yes. While I often work across the full stack, I'm happy to step in as a designer, a developer, or both — depending on what your team needs.

faq.question: Can I see more work that isn't on the Projects page?
faq.answer: Some client work is under NDA, but I'm happy to share additional case studies privately during a call. Just mention it in your message.
